description: Elections Commission - Declare that T. A. I. Priyadharshana as a member of the Lanka Pura Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Lankapura Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new member through an electoral process, which falls squarely under electoral matters and procedures.
